blurb: Guests fish for a variety of species including sharks, tuna, mahi, and bottom fish. Trips range from short shark fishing excursions to full day and specialty trips targeting specific species. Boats are equipped with fishing gear, restrooms, and captains provide instruction and encouragement for all skill levels.
extraNote: Price is for entire group, not per person · Private charters only; no shared charters · Tips customary at 20% for good service · Deck hand available on request for additional $75 · Shark trips depart at 5pm; timing may vary depending on day trip filleting · Sunrise Marina behind Grills Seafood Deck and Tiki Bar, Port Canaveral, FL · Year round

quotes.text: We went out with captain Mike and had an amazing time. We had some pretty rough seas but he took us to a great spot where we hooked a bunch of snook, redfish and even a shark.Mike managed to keep lines in the water pretty much the whole time we were out despite the blue fish breaking lines and stealing our bait.We go out with Sea Leveler every time we come to Florida and every trip has been amazing.We can’t recommend highly enough! These guys always do a great job and we always have a blast!

Captain Steve, on the Sea’s the Day, was a great captain that put us on a lot of huge fish.Very noodle and worked towards the goal of putting us all on fish.Brought a group down from Michigan and we went bottom dropping for grouper, snappers and some of the toughest Amber Jacks in FL.Will be booking him for any future fishing adventures!

Tommy M. Ethan took my sons (teen and elementary age) for a full day. We had a blast. We landed a bunch of king mackerel, a ton of cobia including two nice keepers, plus redfish, some sharks, and a bonito. Ethan was great with the kids, they learned a ton, and we all had a fun time.read moreread less 8/05/2026

Colin T. Had a great time with a lot of help from our guide, Joey. He was attentive and put us in a good spot to catch our limit for the day. He made it easy to have fun and be productive. Looking forward to going out for round 2 when I'm back in Florida.read moreread less 8/03/2026

Ethan took my sons (teen and elementary age) for a full day. We had a blast. We landed a bunch of king mackerel, a ton of cobia including two nice keepers, plus redfish, some sharks, and a bonito. Ethan was great with the kids, they learned a ton, and we all had a fun time.

This trip was the highlight of our vacation. It was my grandson’s first time ever on a boat and he loves fishing. His dream was to catch a shark. ACHIEVED. Absolutely recommend. And the restaurant at the marina will cook your catch right there. Fantastic experience!
